Select all IC50 activity rows in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target name and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by all output columns.
